historical_record.description: The Mayor approved a schedule dedicating six new playgrounds of the 1947 recreation bond program, with South Sunset Playground set for June 27. Later in the year the Parkside District Improvement Club asked for it to be renamed Vicente or West Parkside Playground, so as not to confuse it with the Sunset.

The Recreation Commission engaged William G. Merchant, architect, for the ground and building plans of a new playground and recreation building at South Sunset Playground, the block of 40th and 41st Avenues, Vicente and Wawona.
The Recreation Commission awarded the contract to build the clubhouse at South Sunset Playground to Wellnitz & DeNarde at $23,764, the lowest of five bids.

The South Sunset Senior Center, an expansion of the playground building paid for with a $250,000 state grant and run with the Commission on Aging and Self Help for the Elderly as a senior nutrition site by day and a youth recreation space after 2 p.m., was set for dedication on February 22, 1992.
